summary: KampusRide is a campus-made ride marketplace for the IIUM Gombak community. It keeps the existing peer-to-peer transporter culture but structures it: passenger posts one request → drivers send offers → passenger compares and chooses → in-app chat → ride → two-sided rating. Fares are paid directly to the driver; KampusRide does not process fares or take a per-ride commission.

language.guidance: Write like an IIUM student talking to friends: natural BM with Manglish where it sounds human. Campus-native references (mahallah, kulliyyah, LRT Gombak, class 8AM, rain). Never corporate.

pillars.name: Telegram reality
pillars.goal: One specific real pain in the current Telegram transporter workflow, then the structural KampusRide advantage. Telegram is the old workflow, not the enemy.

pillars.name: IIUM life
pillars.goal: A recognisable campus situation (class, rain, LRT, exams, events, balik kampung).

pillars.name: How it works
pillars.goal: Teach one step of the passenger or driver flow clearly.

pillars.name: Trust & accountability
pillars.goal: Explain ratings, privacy, female preference or rules honestly, including limits.

pillars.name: Community
pillars.goal: Build in public, listen, ask genuine questions.

exemplars.hook: KampusRide ni sebenarnya apa?
exemplars.concept: Introduce KampusRide simply: it organises the existing IIUM transporter behaviour into request → offers → compare → choose → in-app chat → ride → rate. Be transparent that KampusRide is still pre-launch.

exemplars.hook: Kalau Telegram dah ada, kenapa nak buat KampusRide?
exemplars.concept: Respect Telegram for creating the community, then explain the structural gaps KampusRide is designed to fix: scattered DMs, unclear confirmation, negotiation chaos, privacy and weak ride-specific accountability.

exemplars.hook: Kalau nak ride nanti, flow passenger macam mana?
exemplars.concept: Step-by-step pre-launch passenger education: create one ride request, receive driver offers, compare profile/vehicle/rating/offer, counter where relevant, select one driver, chat in-app, complete ride and rate. Do not imply the service is live today.

exemplars.hook: Driver kampus pula guna KampusRide macam mana?
exemplars.concept: Step-by-step driver education: when safely stopped and available, switch to Driver mode, view suitable ride requests, send an offer, respond to counteroffers, wait for passenger selection, then coordinate the selected trip. Never encourage phone interaction while moving.

exemplars.hook: Satu request, semua offer — apa beza dia?
exemplars.concept: Explain why one request with multiple structured offers is easier to compare than negotiating across multiple Telegram DMs. Keep fare language as offers/counteroffers, not a guaranteed fixed fare.

exemplars.hook: KampusRide control harga ke?
exemplars.concept: Explain that KampusRide can show a suggested price guide and structure offers/counteroffers, while the driver and passenger still agree the final fare. Do not imply price fixing or guaranteed cheapest fares.

exemplars.hook: Dah pilih driver, lepas tu apa jadi?
exemplars.concept: Explain selected-match clarity: one chosen driver, trip context, in-app chat and ride status. Contrast with awkwardly closing several separate DMs without claiming no-shows can never happen.

exemplars.hook: Rating dalam KampusRide untuk apa sebenarnya?
exemplars.concept: Explain two-sided ratings/reputation as context and accountability over time, not a safety certificate. Mention useful behaviour signals such as punctuality/respect without inventing real ratings.

exemplars.hook: Female preferred driver tu guarantee ke?
exemplars.concept: Explain clearly that it is a preference designed to prioritise a female driver when available, not a guarantee. Keep the tone respectful and practical for the IIUM community.

exemplars.hook: Cari transporter tak semestinya kena bagi nombor dekat ramai orang.
exemplars.concept: Explain the value of in-app chat and trip context before exposing personal contact details. Connect this to unwanted DMs, sexual spam and scam risk without claiming KampusRide prevents all abuse.

exemplars.hook: Ada platform rules tak sama dengan “fully regulated”.
exemplars.concept: Explain the difference between KampusRide community/platform rules, moderation and accountability versus legal/regulatory classification. Never claim APAD approval, licensed e-hailing status or official IIUM endorsement without confirmation.

exemplars.hook: Nak secure job sampai kena type masa drive? Itu bukan benda yang patut normalize.
exemplars.concept: Use the real Telegram driver-pressure problem. Show how a structured ride feed/offer flow is meant to reduce frantic chat pressure, while stating drivers should only review/respond when safely stopped.

exemplars.hook: Passenger dah confirm. Tengah on the way… chat hilang.
exemplars.concept: Show the frustration of deleted Telegram messages after confirmation and why persistent trip context/selected match is useful. Avoid claiming the app can eliminate cancellations.

exemplars.hook: Driver dah confirm… tapi tak muncul?
exemplars.concept: Talk about no-show frustration. KampusRide can create clearer selected-match history, chat, ride status and ratings; it cannot guarantee no-shows never happen.

exemplars.hook: Nego 4 driver serentak memang penat.
exemplars.concept: Contrast scattered multi-driver negotiation with one request containing visible offers/counteroffers and one final selection.

exemplars.hook: Satu job belum settle, tiga chat lain dah masuk.
exemplars.concept: Show multi-job chat chaos for drivers and why a structured request/offer/selection state is easier to track. Never promise job volume or earnings.

talking_points.text: Dalam Telegram, driver yang nak secure job kadang rasa kena reply atau nego cepat walaupun tengah bergerak. Itu workflow yang kita tak patut normalize. KampusRide susun ride request dan offer dalam satu tempat supaya driver boleh review bila selamat berhenti — bukan berlumba menaip masa memandu.

Bila passenger dah confirm kemudian mesej hilang, driver boleh kehilangan route/context masa dah bersiap atau tengah menuju pickup. KampusRide jadikan request, selected match, chat dan ride status satu flow supaya kurang bergantung pada DM yang berselerak.

No-show tetap boleh berlaku di mana-mana platform. Bezanya, KampusRide ada selected match, in-app chat, ride-status flow dan rating/reputation supaya apa yang berlaku tak sekadar hilang dalam private chat. Accountability lebih jelas, bukan safety guarantee.

Nego dalam banyak DM mudah jadi tak terkawal: siapa offer berapa, siapa dah confirm, siapa masih counter. KampusRide letak suggested price sebagai guide dan kumpulkan offer/counteroffer pada satu ride request. Passenger masih pilih, driver masih boleh offer — cuma flow lebih jelas.

Open group dan random DM boleh membuka ruang kepada spam, scam atau sexual harassment. KampusRide tak boleh janji semua abuse akan hilang, tetapi private contact, authenticated account, in-app chat, trip context, reputation dan moderation beri layer accountability yang Telegram ride arrangement tak dibina khusus untuk sediakan.

Community ride perlukan rules dan accountability, tapi jangan campur-adukkan platform rules dengan legal regulation. KampusRide boleh ada moderation, suspension, trip context dan audit controls. Status undang-undang pula mesti disahkan berasingan — bukan dibuat claim marketing.
Masa buat ride request, pilih female preferred. Bila female driver available, preference itu boleh diprioritikan. Ia preference, bukan guarantee kerana availability boleh berubah.

KampusRide susunkan cara student UIA cari dan offer transporter dalam satu flow: passenger post ride request, driver hantar offer, passenger compare dan pilih, kemudian coordination kekal dalam app. Komuniti yang sama, cara yang lebih tersusun.
Passenger bayar fare terus kepada driver yang dipilih. KampusRide tidak pegang atau process fare ride dan tidak potong komisen per ride. App urus request, offer, chat, ride status dan rating.

channels.role: Main conversation channel with the IIUM community
channels.tone: Real observation or opinion, soft sell, end with one genuine question
ctas: Student UIA — korang pernah kena situasi macam ni?
Passenger — part paling penat dalam transporter flow sekarang apa?
Driver kampus — masalah paling real bila cari job dalam group apa?
Kalau boleh fix satu benda dalam current transporter flow, korang pilih apa?

never: guaranteed safety or that no-shows, scams or harassment are prevented
guaranteed female driver (it is a preference)
guaranteed ride availability, jobs or earnings
APAD approval, licensed e-hailing status or settled legal/regulatory status
fixed or cheapest fares (the suggested price is a guide)
invented user, ride, rating or driver counts
that every driver is an IIUM student or document-verified
that KampusRide employs drivers, owns vehicles, processes fares or takes a per-ride commission
always: Drivers only check or respond when safely stopped; never show phone use while a vehicle is moving.
Treat the Telegram transporter community with respect.
One product idea and one CTA per piece.

visual.setting: Authentic Malaysian university campus life at IIUM Gombak: mahallah, kulliyyah, walkways, LRT Gombak, rain, natural daylight, modest student styling, believable smartphone use.
rules: Use the supplied official KampusRide logo exactly; never redraw it. Without a logo asset use the wordmark as plain text.
Use approved real KampusRide screenshots as UI references; never invent unsupported screens.
No IIUM logo or official marks unless separately approved.
Chats shown on screen must be fictional and anonymised.

modes.label: Install + notifications tutorial
modes.instructions: Public onboarding tutorial. Follow the six fixed slides exactly. Not a general introduction, not a Telegram comparison, not a launch announcement.
modes.example_request: Create a public how-to showing students how to install KampusRide on Android and iPhone, then enable notifications.
qa_notes: Do not turn this into a general KampusRide introduction or Telegram comparison.
Use approved KampusRide logo/app icon and real screenshots where available.
Do not claim App Store/Play Store availability while KampusRide is installed as a web app/PWA.

fixed.script:
SLIDE 1 — HOW TO INSTALL KAMPUSRIDE 📱
Tak perlu cari dekat App Store atau Play Store. Install terus dari browser.

SLIDE 2 — ANDROID: OPEN IN CHROME
Buka KampusRide menggunakan Google Chrome.

SLIDE 3 — ANDROID: INSTALL APP
Tap ⋮ → Install app → Install. KampusRide akan muncul dekat Home Screen.

SLIDE 4 — IPHONE: ADD TO HOME SCREEN
Buka KampusRide dalam Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen → Open as Web App → Add.

SLIDE 5 — ENABLE NOTIFICATIONS 🔔
Buka KampusRide dan tap Allow bila notification permission keluar. Ini penting untuk driver offer, ride updates dan trip status.

SLIDE 6 — DONE ✅
KampusRide dah ready dekat Home Screen. From Campus, For You.

modes.label: Simulation-only beta recruitment (30 days)
modes.instructions: Public items: keep the product completely anonymous (no name, logo, screenshots, palette, website or QR). Call it a "new UIA Transporter app". State clearly: guided simulation only, no real trips, fares or payments. Private items: KampusRide may be named; every activity is simulation-only.
modes.example_request: Simulation-only beta recruitment: 20 passenger testers and 10 student-driver testers at IIUM Gombak.
qa_notes: Public recruitment must not reveal the product identity in text or visuals.
Do not use any supplied brand assets, screenshots, icons or brand colours in public recruitment.
State clearly that this is a guided simulation with no real trips, fares or payments.
Do not imply official IIUM endorsement or invent contact details.

plan_sequence.hook: Beta testers wanted — IIUM Gombak.
plan_sequence.concept: PUBLIC ANONYMOUS RECRUITMENT. Invite 20 passenger testers and 10 student-driver testers for a new UIA Transporter app. Use “UIA Transporter app” as the familiar community-facing description, but do not use the KampusRide name, logo, screenshots or identifying product details. State clearly that this is a guided simulation only.
plan_sequence.cta: Message the admin to join. Limited slots.

plan_sequence.hook: Selalu cari transporter sekitar UIA Gombak?
plan_sequence.concept: PUBLIC ANONYMOUS RECRUITMENT. Invite passenger testers who can evaluate whether posting a request, comparing options and choosing a driver feels clear. No real trip, fare or payment will occur.

plan_sequence.hook: Student driver UIA Gombak — nak bantu test flow baru?
plan_sequence.concept: PUBLIC ANONYMOUS RECRUITMENT. Invite student drivers to test request review, offers and selection while safely parked. Do not imply jobs, earnings, real passengers or real driving.
plan_sequence.cta: Student driver tester berminat? Message admin.

plan_sequence.hook: Simulation-only beta tu maksudnya apa?
plan_sequence.concept: PUBLIC ANONYMOUS RECRUITMENT. Explain that participants follow guided fictional scenarios inside the app. There are no real trips, no fares, no payment and no obligation to continue after testing.
plan_sequence.cta: Nak tengok flow dulu? Message admin.

plan_sequence.hook: Siapa boleh join beta test ni?
plan_sequence.concept: PUBLIC ANONYMOUS RECRUITMENT. Open to the IIUM Gombak community. Separate passenger and student-driver tester roles. Keep screening private with the admin and do not collect sensitive details publicly.
plan_sequence.cta: Pilih role anda dan message admin.

plan_sequence.hook: Tak perlu jadi tech expert untuk jadi beta tester.
plan_sequence.concept: PUBLIC ANONYMOUS RECRUITMENT. Testers only need to follow a short guided scenario, say where they feel confused and report any broken step. Do not reveal the app identity publicly.
plan_sequence.cta: Boleh bagi honest feedback? Message admin.

plan_sequence.hook: Last call: passenger + student driver beta slots.
plan_sequence.concept: PUBLIC ANONYMOUS RECRUITMENT. Give a final limited-slots reminder for the 20 passenger and 10 student-driver target. Repeat simulation-only, no real trip and no payment.

plan_sequence.hook: Welcome to the private testing group.
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE TESTER GROUP. Reveal KampusRide here, thank accepted testers and restate that all activities are guided simulations only. No real ride, payment or live commitment.
plan_sequence.cta: Reply with your assigned tester role.

plan_sequence.hook: Sebelum test, baca 5 ground rules ni.
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE TESTER GROUP. Cover respectful conduct, fictional scenario data, no real pickup, no payment, no sharing private group materials and honest issue reporting.

plan_sequence.hook: Quick setup check sebelum simulation bermula.
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE TESTER GROUP. Confirm testers can open KampusRide, understand Passenger and Driver modes and know where to report issues. Avoid collecting passwords, OTPs or sensitive identity data.

plan_sequence.hook: Passenger simulation 01: post satu request fiksyen.
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE SIMULATION. Guide passenger testers to create a fictional IIUM route, time and passenger count. Explicitly prohibit using a real immediate trip need.
plan_sequence.cta: Report step pertama yang rasa tak clear.

plan_sequence.hook: Driver simulation 01: review request masa safely parked.
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE SIMULATION. Guide student-driver testers to inspect a fictional request and judge whether route, time and passenger information are sufficient. No driving occurs.

plan_sequence.hook: Suggested price tu nampak macam guide atau fixed fare?
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE SIMULATION. Test whether passenger and driver understand that the displayed anchor is guidance for a fictional scenario, not a guaranteed or processed fare.

plan_sequence.hook: Driver simulation 02: submit fictional offer.
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE SIMULATION. Test the offer form, validation and confirmation state using fictional values. No money changes hands.

plan_sequence.hook: Passenger simulation 02: compare beberapa offer.
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE SIMULATION. Ask passenger testers to compare fictional driver options, price, context and reputation signals without implying any safety guarantee.

plan_sequence.hook: Counteroffer flow: jelas atau terlalu banyak step?
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE SIMULATION. Run one fictional negotiation round and check whether both roles understand whose turn it is and what the latest amount means.
plan_sequence.cta: Screenshot atau describe step yang confusing.

plan_sequence.hook: Passenger pilih driver — kedua-dua side nampak confirmation yang sama?
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE SIMULATION. Test the selected-match state and make sure other fictional offers resolve clearly. No real driver is dispatched.
plan_sequence.cta: Passenger + driver confirm apa yang anda nampak.

plan_sequence.hook: Lepas match, trip context + chat cukup jelas tak?
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE SIMULATION. Exchange only test messages. Check whether route and selected-match context remain visible. Do not share phone numbers or personal details.
plan_sequence.cta: Apa context yang patut kekal visible?

plan_sequence.hook: Test status flow tanpa bergerak ke mana-mana.
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE SIMULATION. Step through fictional ride statuses while everyone remains stationary. Never encourage app use while driving.

plan_sequence.hook: Complete + rating flow: useful atau sekadar decoration?
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE SIMULATION. Complete the fictional scenario and test two-sided ratings as accountability context, never as safety certification.

plan_sequence.hook: Simulation edge case: passenger cancel sebelum match.
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE SIMULATION. Test a fictional passenger cancellation and whether the driver receives clear state changes. No real inconvenience occurs.

plan_sequence.hook: Simulation edge case: driver tarik balik offer.
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE SIMULATION. Test fictional offer withdrawal and whether passenger options update clearly.

plan_sequence.hook: Kalau no-show berlaku, sistem patut record apa?
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE DISCUSSION. Discuss status, evidence and moderation needs using a fictional scenario. Do not claim KampusRide can prevent all no-shows.

plan_sequence.hook: Info apa patut private sebelum dan selepas match?
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE DISCUSSION. Review personal-data exposure, trip context and in-app chat. Do not promise complete protection from abuse.

plan_sequence.hook: Boleh faham flow ni tanpa founder explain setiap step?
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE RETEST. Ask testers to repeat the core fictional flow with minimal guidance and log every point requiring admin intervention.

plan_sequence.hook: Top 5 blockers: mana wajib fix dulu?
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE FEEDBACK. Summarise only verified tester findings. Rank core-loop blockers above visual preferences and do not invent metrics.

plan_sequence.hook: Passenger retest: adakah flow sekarang lebih clear?
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE RETEST. Repeat the fictional passenger path after fixes and compare against the previously logged friction points.
plan_sequence.cta: Mark each issue FIXED / PARTIAL / OPEN.

plan_sequence.hook: Driver retest: offer flow dah cukup practical?
plan_sequence.concept: PRIVATE RETEST. Repeat the fictional driver path while safely stationary and verify offer, withdrawal, selection and status feedback.
plan_sequence.cta: Mark each issue FIXED / PARTIAL / OPEN.
